detail: Dropped rows with duplicate encounter_id (kept first occurrence)
Mapped 10 raw variants (M/Male/m/MALE/'Male '/F/Female/f/FEMALE/' Female') to M/F
Left missing gender as null rather than imputing a guessed value
Parsed 3 mixed date formats (ISO / MM-DD-YYYY / DD-Mon-YYYY) into a single datetime type
Nulled impossible ages (<=0 or >110) rather than guessing a replacement
Nulled impossible LOS values (<0 or >90 days, e.g. entry errors like 999 or -2)
Flagged (not removed) costs > 3x the 99th percentile ($478,899) as likely billing errors for analyst review
Retained rows with missing diagnosis code, flagged for downstream exclusion from diagnosis-specific analysis
Retained rows with missing cost, excluded from cost-driver analysis only
